subject: Unfreeze trial: sandbox extension & pilot credits request
body:
From: Sophie Meyers <sophie@packable.com>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Unfreeze trial: sandbox extension & pilot credits request

Hi Hiro,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the SDK looked great and the team is excited. We hit an unexpected blocker during our data migration this morning where our adapter throws repeated KV cache mismatches when sequences exceed 8k tokens. Engineering has paused the integration sprint to investigate.

We were hoping you could:
- Extend our sandbox/trial window by 14 days so we can finish the migration without losing momentum, and
- Provide a small pilot credit (about $1,200) to cover the extra inference from re-running tests after the migration fix.

I attached the error logs and a rough timeline. We’re targeting a go-live by end of January if we can get past this. Let me know what you need from us.

Thanks,
Sophie Meyers
Head of Integrations, Packable Inc.
Attachments: integration_error_logs.zip, poc_timeline.xlsx

-----

From: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Meyers <sophie@packable.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:21:34 -0800
Subject: Re: Unfreeze trial: sandbox extension & pilot credits request

Hi Sophie — sorry to hear you hit that. Appreciate the logs, they’re helpful. Quick notes:

- We can extend the sandbox window while you complete the migration.
- Pilot credits request looks reasonable but I need a quick sign-off from RevOps for dollar approval. I’ve looped in Ben and Lauren to confirm scope and the customer success plan.

Ben, Lauren — can you confirm the amount we can approve without exec sign-off and if we want contract conditions (e.g., usage cap, expiration)? Also flagged INF-2123 in our backlog for the KV issue pattern (link: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2123).

Sophie — could your eng lead share a minimal repro (a short sequence and config) so our infra team can triage? If you prefer, we can stand up a quick joint debugging session tomorrow.

Best,
Hiro Tanaka
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

-----

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Meyers <sophie@packable.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:44:09 -0800
Subject: Re: Unfreeze trial: sandbox extension & pilot credits request

Hi team — quick internal note and recommendation:

- Approved sandbox extension: 14 days (no change to account tier).
- Pilot credit: we can approve up to $1,250 off the hosted trial balance for Packable without needing director approval.
- Conditions: credits apply to sandbox/hosted test usage only, expire 45 days after issue, and we ask Packable to sign a short pilot addendum (1 page) confirming the troubleshooting collaboration and expected go-live window.

Lauren, can you please prepare the pilot addendum and notify RevOps to attach the $1,250 credit code to the Packable HubSpot deal (PKG-347)? Sophie — if that works, I’ll loop Marissa to confirm we add the credit and push the extension.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Meyers <sophie@packable.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 14:21:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Unfreeze trial: sandbox extension & pilot credits request

Ben — approved.

Authorization: one-time $1,250 trial credit (promo code will be generated) + 14-day sandbox extension.
Controls/notes:
- Credit is non-refundable and applies only to test/sandbox calls tied to this pilot.
- Expiry: credit expires 45 days from issuance.
- Require signed pilot addendum before credit is posted. Lauren to attach addendum and RevOps will post credit to HubSpot deal PKG-347.

Sophie — you should see an email from RevOps with the addendum and a DocuSign link shortly. Once we receive the signed copy, we’ll issue the credit and manually extend the sandbox window. If you want the debugging session, Hiro’s available tomorrow 10–11am PT.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior RevOps Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-questionnaire-filled.pdf

-----

From: Sophie Meyers <sophie@packable.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 15:02:40 -0800
Subject: Re: Unfreeze trial: sandbox extension & pilot credits request

Hi Marissa and team — that works, thank you. I’ve routed the pilot addendum to our legal and will sign it today. We’ll also schedule the debugging session with Hiro for tomorrow morning. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Sophie
Head of Integrations, Packable Inc.

Attachments referenced in thread: integration_error_logs.zip, poc_timeline.xlsx, SOC2-questionnaire-filled.pdf

Related links: HubSpot deal PKG-347 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/PKG-347)
